Class MetroOptimizer.ConstraintsBuilder

java.lang.Object
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.optimizer.MetroOptimizer.ConstraintsBuilder
Enclosing class:
MetroOptimizer
public static final class MetroOptimizer.ConstraintsBuilder extends Object
Fluent builder for defining optimization constraints. Constraints define hard and soft limits on the search space including budget, geographic restrictions, compliance requirements, redundancy tiers, and latency bounds.

All constraints are optional. When omitted, the optimizer uses unconstrained defaults.

  • Method Details

    • monthlyBudget

      public MetroOptimizer.ConstraintsBuilder monthlyBudget(double min, double max)
      Sets a monthly budget range in USD used purely as a reporting ceiling. The budget is reported against, never enforced: no metro is excluded for falling outside the range, and the range does not feed the cost scoring dimension. After optimization the estimated monthly total is compared against max; if it exceeds max, the result's within_budget flag is set to false and an over-budget BUDGET_EXCEEDED finding is surfaced — but the selected metros are unchanged. The min bound is not currently checked or reported against.
      Parameters:
      min - the minimum monthly spend in USD (currently informational only — not enforced or reported against)
      max - the maximum monthly spend in USD; the estimate is reported against this ceiling and an over-budget result raises a finding
      Returns:
      this builder for method chaining

    • compliance

      public MetroOptimizer.ConstraintsBuilder compliance(ComplianceZone... zones)
      Sets compliance zone requirements for data sovereignty. A deployment satisfies the requested zones when each zone is covered by at least one recommended metro: candidacy keeps any metro that helps satisfy at least one zone, scoring grades each metro by the fraction of requested zones its region is allowed by, and a zone the selected set leaves uncovered raises a COMPLIANCE_GAP risk finding. A metro outside every requested zone's allowed regions is excluded from candidacy (unless force-included via requireMetro(...), which is then flagged as a compliance gap).
      Parameters:
      zones - the compliance zones to enforce (e.g., ComplianceZone.EU_GDPR)
      Returns:
      this builder for method chaining
      See Also:
      • ComplianceZone

    • maxLatencyMs

      public MetroOptimizer.ConstraintsBuilder maxLatencyMs(double maxMs)
      Sets a hard upper bound on latency from any recommended metro to any user site. During candidate filtering, any metro whose estimated latency to any user site exceeds this threshold is excluded from candidacy.

      The threshold is compared against the engine's per-metro-to-site latency estimate in milliseconds — the same figures used by the latency score dimension and surfaced in MetroRecommendation.getSiteLatencies() and the LatencyMatrix: Equinix Fabric metro-to-metro avgLatency where published, otherwise a Haversine fiber-distance estimate (great-circle distance × 1.4 fiber-routing multiplier × 4.9 μs/km).

      Metros force-included via requireMetro(...) bypass this filter; a required metro that breaches the bound is surfaced as a LATENCY_THRESHOLD risk finding instead of being excluded.

      Parameters:
      maxMs - the maximum acceptable latency in milliseconds (values <= 0 disable the filter)
      Returns:
      this builder for method chaining
